notes: Currency production is also affected by Polarity: being placed near its positive-pole Wublin boosts production up to 25%, while its negative-pole Wublin reduces it up to 25%. The Polarity Amplifier (unlocked by collecting more unique monsters on Wublin Island) extends positive-pole range and shrinks negative-pole range over time. Also, a Wublin only gets the full effect from another Wublin of equal or higher rarity — an Epic Wublin gets no benefit from a Common one, for instance.
